companyUnderstanding.ingestionSummary: CSV-only evidence identifies Ridge Line Remodeling as a Greater Denver residential remodeling/general contractor focused on kitchen and bathroom projects. The strongest supported strategic foundation is a homeowner need for clearer scope and timeline visibility, with fixed-scope proposals and photo progress updates positioned as relevant company-provided mechanisms. The stated conversion action is a free on-site estimate. Licensing, bonding, and project-volume statements remain unverified company claims, and permit inclusion is explicitly conditional on scoping.
